object.setPath:
(value) =>
    (path.length === 0 ? replacement : updatePath(value, path, () => replacement, false)) as any
object.modifyPath:
(value) =>
    (path.length === 0
      ? f(value as any)
      : updatePath(value, path, (current) => f(current as any), true)) as any
object.mergeDeep:
(left) =>
    deepMerge(left, right, options, [], new WeakMap()) as any
